workspace.out: FERB's workspace (<TMP>/ws-link/.ferb/workspace) is a link to <TMP>/ws-link/elsewhere, not a folder. A link there could open FERB's own files to its tools, so FERB won't start until you move the link away (FERB then makes a fresh workspace).
FERB's workspace (<TMP>/ws-file/.ferb/workspace) is not a plain folder in FERB's home, so FERB won't start until you move it away (FERB then makes a fresh workspace).
